pages.text: There will be a party in the alley tonight. Each home will bring one thing to eat.
Coco's bread takes a long time to bake, so it will be ready last. "My bread will go on the table too."
A long table stood in the middle of the alley. It was already full of dishes.
Mr. Pig lifted the whole table. "I'll make more room!"
The table tipped! The dishes slid toward both ends.
Everyone rushed to catch the dishes. Only the middle of the table was empty.
Just then, Coco arrived. Steam rose from the freshly baked bread.
Coco's bread went in the empty middle. It fitted perfectly.
The party began. Coco's bread was the first to be gone.
Only a few crumbs remained on Coco's plate. Mr. Pig silently puffed out his chest and pointed to the middle of the table.
